newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR steady to slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR steady to slightly higher.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were unchanged to marginally higher as some banks were anticipating a slight rate uptick next week, traders said.
One trader said some players were expecting liquidity to tighten early next week as short-term reverse repos were expected to have siphoned off some liquidity.
The rate hike in the Central Bank's special series T-bill rates also prompted banks to adjust their rates higher.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks are willing to swap pesos for dollars.
